Q8537.reason: What can justify punishment depends on which concept of punishment is in play, so the conceptual and justificatory questions have to be kept apart.

Q6097.reason: In most states a grant to someone and the heirs of his body is a fee simple in that grantee, so the later deed leaves the niece with nothing.

Q8324.reason: Extreme agitation and aggression point to excessive dopamine activity, and seizure-like firing is the only option that describes overactivity rather than a dopamine deficit.
